user.title: Connect to Pangolin
user.description: Uses the Pangolin Integration API. Self-hosted instances must have the Integration API enabled and reachable.

data_description.url: Scheme and host of your Integration API. /v1 is shown beside the box and filled in for you.
data_description.api_key: Organization API key, or a root key if you want to pick the organization from a list

features.title: Choose features
features.description:
Features this API key can use are listed and ticked. Unavailable: {unavailable}

Enable/disable and restart also need the matching Update or Restart permission in Pangolin. That can't be checked in advance without changing something, so a missing permission shows as an error when you use the control.

org_manual.title: Enter organization ID
org_manual.description: This is an organization-scoped key, and Pangolin only lets root keys list organizations. Enter the organization ID, which you can find in the Pangolin dashboard URL.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Pangolin Integration API.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected or lacks the required permissions.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from Pangolin. Check the URL and organization ID.
error.no_orgs: This key can't see any organizations.
error.org_denied: This key can't access that organization. Check the ID, or use a key created in that organization.

abort.already_configured: This Pangolin organization is already configured.
